architecture_profile.summary: General-purpose Windows software agent operating through explicitly selected tools.
capabilities: Inspect and change local software state through selected tools.
unavailable_actions: Cannot sense or affect the physical world unless a device-specific tool exposes it.
observable_state: Can observe only data returned by selected tools and explicit goal context.
required_dependencies: Requires the configured model provider and each selected tool's runtime dependencies.
privilege_boundaries: Runs in its Scheduled Task user context; administrative actions require that account to have access.
physical_constraints: Has no assumed camera, microphone, actuator, display, or other physical interface.
known_failure_modes: Interactive commands and unbounded output can confuse the agent or exhaust its token budget.
Command output may be incomplete, stale, or misinterpreted and must be verified.
uncertainty: Hardware, network reachability, installed commands, and current privileges are unknown until observed.

tools.name: shell
tools.documentation: Shell, Description: Executes a shell command and returns stdout/stderr, Command - shell:COMMAND, Example - shell:echo hi

tools.name: memadd
tools.documentation: Memory, Description: Stores temporary context memory for the current session, Command - memadd:TEXT_OR_KEY=VALUE, Example - memadd:User prefers Python

tools.name: google_search
tools.documentation: GoogleSearch, Description: Searches the public web with Gemini Google Search grounding and returns grounded text plus sources, Command - google_search:QUERY, Example - google_search:latest Python release

tools.name: search
tools.documentation: CustomSearch, Description: Uses the Pigion DDGS search implementation or extracts URL content, Command - search:QUERY_OR_URL, Example - search:openai api

tools.name: return
tools.documentation: Return, Description: Returns the final answer, Command - return:TEXT, Example - return:Done

tools.name: askuser
tools.documentation: AskUser, Description: Asks the user for information, Command - askuser:TEXT, Example - askuser:Provide location
